subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observed that the situation was 'accurately described' by Asha's characterization of me as an insane mage who had converted to Lolthism.
source_quote: Grygum, at some point in this sequence, observed that the situation was 'accurately described' by Asha's characterization of me as an insane mage who had converted to Lolthism. He meant it kindly. Or as kindly as Grygum observes anything, which is with the steady, clear-eyed precision of a man keeping accurate records.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was battered from her forty-foot drop courtesy of Zalthir's extraordinary grip-and-release approach to aerial combat, was still moving, still conjuring, still calling down divine fire on Daz and Nym Duskryn with the focused fury of someone who had not yet accepted that this was over.
source_quote: Ilvara, battered from her forty-foot drop courtesy of Zalthir's extraordinary grip-and-release approach to aerial combat, was still moving, still conjuring, still calling down divine fire on Daz and Nym Duskryn with the focused fury of someone who had not yet accepted that this was over.

subject: fungal cavern
fact: The bridge cracked under her. Thorin's work.
source_quote: The bridge cracked under her. Thorin's work.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir processed the question of unnamed creatures with his characteristic meditative calm, saying 'That's awesome.'
source_quote: Zalthir processed this with his characteristic meditative calm. 'That's awesome.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I am not gonna leave. Everyone here... to fight for me without me also participating. I don't give a damn if you get paid. The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying.'
source_quote: I am not gonna leave. Everyone here... to fight for me without me also participating. I don't give a damn if you get paid. The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying.

subject: Nym Duskryn
fact: Nym Duskryn asked, 'Can I kill your brother?' delivered flat, a genuine inquiry, redirected frustration finding the nearest available target with a professional's efficiency.
source_quote: Can I kill your brother? Delivered flat. A genuine inquiry, redirected frustration finding the nearest available target with a professional's efficiency.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira's hand closed around Daz's arm like a vice, saying, 'Come with me if you want to live, you idiot.'
source_quote: Kaelira's hand closed around my arm like a vice. 'Come with me if you want to live, you idiot.'

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree declared, 'Who are you? You must be traitors! Traitors to Lolth!'
source_quote: Who are you? You must be traitors! Traitors to Lolth!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'No, these are friends of Lolth, and they're here to help.' The words came out smooth. No hesitation, no announcement, no explanation.
source_quote: No, these are friends of Lolth, and they're here to help. The words came out smooth. No hesitation, no announcement, no explanation.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast Fireball in a shaped arc around everything he wanted to keep, sculpting the spell to exclude allies and spare Glabbagool.
source_quote: I cast Fireball in a shaped arc around everything I wanted to keep.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, our sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion, had already taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and survived.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion who had been, from what I could tell, simply trying to participate in the ambient conversation of the battle — had already taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and survived.

subject: Jorlan Duskryn
fact: Jorlan Duskryn went staggering across the cavern floor after being hit by a lightning bolt.
source_quote: Jorlan Duskryn went staggering across the cavern floor

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.'
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.

subject: tunnel mouth
fact: Elite drow soldiers were standing at the threshold of a crisis they had presumably accepted a contract to resolve, now stymied by a wall of insects and a mage with insufficient spell preparation.
source_quote: There's a category of failure I find almost aesthetically interesting — not the grand collapse, but the petty logistical one. They had the firepower. They had the numbers. What they did not have was Dispel Magic, and so they stood in the tunnel debating whether to charge while a 4th-level fireball was introduced into the conversation.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this.' She was not wrong. That is probably going to matter later.
source_quote: The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this. She was not wrong. That is probably going to matter later. I filed it accordingly.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place.
source_quote: Ilvara — Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place — folded and went still, and then, because the Underdark does not allow even death to be dignified, she did not simply fall.

subject: poisonous spore cloud
fact: She erupted — a cloud of poisonous spores, billowing outward from what had been a person. A woman who had traded herself to a fungal demon lord, and what was left was biology, not identity. Not even a body. Just spores.
source_quote: She *erupted*. A cloud of poisonous spores, billowing outward from what had been a person. A woman who had traded herself to a fungal demon lord, and what was left was biology, not identity. Not even a body. Just spores.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'Not ideal,' immediately. 'How big is the cloud?' I was glad I was standing back. This is the whole of my commentary on the death of Ilvara Mizzrym. Pragmatic wisdom. I was standing back. The cloud was noted. I took notes.
source_quote: Not ideal,' immediately. 'How big is the cloud?' I was glad I was standing back. This is the whole of my commentary on the death of Ilvara Mizzrym. Pragmatic wisdom. I was standing back. The cloud was noted. I took notes.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama. I want to be clear about that. The romantic betrayal. The scarring. The fury. The way he had broken from us to pursue her through an active insect plague. It was genuinely interesting. I filed it, appreciated it, and continued.'
source_quote: I was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama. I want to be clear about that. The romantic betrayal. The scarring. The fury. The way he had broken from us to pursue her through an active insect plague. It was genuinely interesting. I filed it, appreciated it, and continued.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I am still going to go ahead and attack her.'
source_quote: I am still going to go ahead and attack her.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'The bolt found her this time. Radiant light. Clean and bright and final.'
source_quote: The bolt found her this time. Radiant light. Clean and bright and final.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I know what's real. I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society. I know all of that. But right now, in this cavern, Asha thinks I serve Lolth, and that belief is load-bearing.'
source_quote: I know what's real. I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society. I know all of that. But right now, in this cavern, Asha thinks I serve Lolth, and that belief is load-bearing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I find transactional arguments interesting when they're offered as though they should be persuasive to the person whose life is being treated as currency.'
source_quote: I find transactional arguments interesting when they're offered as though they should be persuasive to the person whose life is being treated as currency.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I am capable of elegance, and that was not it. But it was accurate, and it was what I meant, and Nym heard it correctly because her expression shifted from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.'
source_quote: I am capable of elegance, and that was not it. But it was accurate, and it was what I meant, and Nym heard it correctly because her expression shifted from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I am an Evoker, trained in Menzoberranzan where the destructive arts were considered the only magic worth taking seriously.'
source_quote: An Evoker — and I am an Evoker, trained in Menzoberranzan where the destructive arts were considered the only magic worth taking seriously — learns to carve exceptions into area spells.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'The ability is called Sculpt Spells, and it means I can reach into a Fireball and pull specific individuals out of harm's way, leaving the fire to do its work on everything else in the radius.'
source_quote: The ability is called Sculpt Spells, and it means I can reach into a Fireball and pull specific individuals out of harm's way, leaving the fire to do its work on everything else in the radius.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'The question of what spell to use is, in the end, always a question of geometry. You are managing a volume. You are thinking about who is inside it, who is outside it, and how much of what you need is inside relative to the damage you're prepared to accept on the edges.'
source_quote: The question of what spell to use is, in the end, always a question of geometry. You are managing a volume. You are thinking about who is inside it, who is outside it, and how much of what you need is inside relative to the damage you're prepared to accept on the edges.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I am the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard, standing in the smoke of my own fireball, surrounded by people who were fighting because he refused to leave.'
source_quote: The feared mage of the Ember Vanguard, standing in the smoke of his own fireball, surrounded by people who were fighting because he refused to leave.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.'
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'It is a simple arrangement and I had been making it complicated since the moment she arrived.'
source_quote: It is a simple arrangement and I had been making it complicated since the moment she arrived.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I don't, particularly. What I care about is that Thorin and Grygum and Zalthir are in active combat with a corrupted high priestess and a field of biting insects and what appears to be an inexhaustible supply of Drow reinforcements, and the idea of standing in a shadow while that happens is — I want to find a precise word — unacceptable.'
source_quote: I don't, particularly. What I care about is that Thorin and Grygum and Zalthir are in active combat with a corrupted high priestess and a field of biting insects and what appears to be an inexhaustible supply of Drow reinforcements, and the idea of standing in a shadow while that happens is — I want to find a precise word — unacceptable.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I have been maintaining a Lolth-follower identity with Asha Vandree for long enough that the fiction has its own momentum — you learn to stop thinking of it as lying and start thinking of it as consistent characterization.'
source_quote: I have been maintaining a Lolth-follower identity with Asha Vandree for long enough that the fiction has its own momentum — you learn to stop thinking of it as lying and start thinking of it as consistent characterization.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'The lie barely costs anything when you're already committed to the architecture.'
source_quote: The lie barely costs anything when you're already committed to the architecture.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society.'
source_quote: I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I was standing back. The cloud was noted. I took notes.'
source_quote: I was standing back. The cloud was noted. I took notes.

fact: Daz said, 'I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.'
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.
